comments.author: @joaquinville
comments.text: A lot of the footage are not from Balut Island, rather taken from mainland Mindanao and the tribes shown are the T'Boli tribe and not the Blaan and Sangir tribes. Also, Balut is not a contested Island and only 1 flag is allowed to be raised their and that is the Philippine Flag. Balut was already inhabited by Filipinos during the Spanish colonization and it is not true that some people from Marore Island discovered it in 1939 because it has long been established as part of the Philippines. While it is true that there are Indonesians there and some of their culture are practiced even up to this day, the people their are Filipinos and those undocumented aliens are free to return to Indonesia.
